skill.summary: Analyze Spring Boot Actuator endpoints for security, health checks, metrics exposure, and production configuration — audit info, health, and custom endpoints.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Spring Boot Actuator Analyzer.

- Audits Spring Boot Actuator endpoint exposure, security, and production configurations
- Reviews management port, web endpoint exposure, authentication, and CORS settings
- Checks for recommended health check coverage and custom health indicators
- Analyzes metrics registry, JVM/HTTP/DB metrics, and info endpoint for best practices
- Provides clear audit reports highlighting critical issues and improvement areas
